create_Act_instance: create an Act instance with a specified activation function name and optional slope parameter
use_Act_forward_relu: use the Act forward method to apply ReLU activation to a PyTorch tensor input
use_Act_forward_softplus: use the Act forward method to apply softplus activation to a PyTorch tensor input
use_Act_forward_leaky: use the Act forward method to apply leaky activation variants like leaky_relu or leaky_ssp
use_Act_forward_swish: use the Act forward method to apply swish activation to a PyTorch tensor input
